active_space.source: HCS + H2S outer exit: retain CAS(3,3), HCS occupied pi/SOMO/pi-star natural 20-22, one doublet D1. The fixed control opening the actual H2S lone pair (source 19) changes the near energy by only 1.7e-7/1.5e-7 Eh (DZ/TZ), with no reported far change and added occupation 2.00000. Opening source 18 instead adds HCS correlation, not the H2S donor. The optimized occupied union expels the intended H2S direction and is not evidence for adding it. Both shift labels share the verified product endpoint but retain their own request identities. These are evidence-based chemical active-space choices. They do not certify quantitative CASPT2-F12, angular, relaxed-path or plateau convergence. Preserve production orbital/state/connectivity guards. Retain direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz CBS power 3.7, a separate 30 A asymptote, and the existing mapped correction coordinate and COM dividing surfaces. No existing production model is changed here.
